verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a built-in conversational search capability that returns AI-generated answers grounded in the user's own indexed content, which covers part of getting AI output from your data inside the product. It does not document AI-generated insights or proactive suggestions. Analytics only tracks queries, clicks, and conversions with no AI layer, and the MCP integration runs in an external AI client rather than inside the product. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or suggestions about the data (e.g., analytics or relevance recommendations), in-product AI surfacing beyond Q&A, depth documentation of conversational search, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Let users ask questions and get real answers, grounded in your own content.
exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API
